tiers.boundary: Separate guest kernel; provider-enforced ceilings; no shares beyond the allowlist; network enforced outside the guest; provider not controllable from inside.
Shared kernel (host, or the shared WSL utility VM). Not VM-grade; runs only when named explicitly, with a disclosure.

notes.create: Refuses if the instance name exists.
notes.stop: Graceful, then forced after stop_timeout_s (default 120, maximum 300).
notes.destroy: Idempotent; removes only the instance and its storage.
notes.exec: Operator and provisioning only; never offered to agents.

artifact_labels.provider: string, for example incus-vm, incus-container, qemu-whpx, lima-vz, lima-qemu, wsl2-distro

properties.name: Separate kernel
properties.strong: The guest runs its own kernel under a hypervisor.
properties.trusted_workload: Kernel shared with the host (Incus container) or with the WSL utility VM.
properties.inspection: Provider type from a provider query; compare uname -r inside the guest with the host (or the Owner's WSL kernel).

properties.name: Provider-enforced ceilings
properties.strong: vCPU, memory, root and scratch disk set outside the guest: Incus limits.cpu, limits.memory, root size; QEMU -smp, -m, image virtual size; Lima cpus, memory, disk. These are the outer caps for decision 0001's per-conversation overrides; Moby caps (F-04.1) sit inside them.
properties.trusted_workload: Incus container: cgroup limits. WSL: VM-wide, shared with every distribution, observed only.
properties.inspection: Provider query; inside: nproc equals declared vCPU, MemTotal between 85% and 100% of declared memory, lsblk -b shows declared root and scratch sizes.

properties.name: No automatic host shares
properties.strong: No provider share except the single allowlisted exchange directory, if declared; none for the Windows QEMU profile.
properties.trusted_workload: Same allowlist; WSL automount and mountFsTab disabled in the distribution's own wsl.conf.
properties.inspection: findmnt -t 9p,virtiofs,drvfs,fuse.sshfs,cifs,nfs,smb3 shows nothing beyond the allowlist; /mnt/c absent; full findmnt -J compared with the declared mount table.

properties.name: Repository exchange and scratch only
properties.strong: Exchange is guest-owned storage populated over the management channel (git over SSH on a loopback forward, or incus file push); a provider share only as one explicit allowlisted directory outside the Owner's profile; scratch is a second guest disk. The Windows QEMU profile uses no host filesystem share.
properties.trusted_workload: Same model; the WSL exchange lives inside the dedicated distribution's filesystem, never under /mnt.
properties.inspection: Provider device list shows only root and scratch (plus the allowlisted share, if any); findmnt shows exchange and scratch at their declared mount points.

properties.name: No Owner secrets
properties.strong: Launch environment scrubbed to an allowlist; seed and cloud-init hold only the per-instance public key and non-secret config. Allowed and labelled: per-instance guest-local SSH keypair and OH_SECRET_KEY. Provider and LLM credentials only behind the brokered inference endpoint class.
properties.inspection: Scan pid 1 environment, the agent login shell environment, home directories and /etc for Owner-class patterns, with a planted positive control per class.

properties.name: No host-management sockets or interop
properties.strong: No docker, podman, incus or libvirt socket from the host; no X11 or WSLg sockets; any provider agent channel (incus-agent, QEMU guest agent) declared and host-to-guest only.
properties.trusted_workload: WSL: interop.enabled=false and appendWindowsPath=false in the distribution's wsl.conf; WSLg is VM-wide, observed and disclosed, never written.
properties.inspection: find / -xdev -type s and ss -xl against the declared agent channel; no DOCKER_HOST, host docker.sock, /tmp/.X11-unix or /mnt/wslg; for WSL, launching a Windows .exe fails.

properties.name: Network posture
properties.strong: NAT or managed bridge, never bridged onto the Owner's LAN; inbound only via explicit forwards bound to host 127.0.0.1; guest-to-host denied except the enumerated endpoint classes management, exchange, inference, provision (provision may be phase-limited); egress allowlist enforced outside the guest at a named enforcement point (candidates: Incus bridge ACLs; QEMU SLIRP restrict=on with guestfwd to a host-side allowlisting proxy); denial holds from inside a container in the guest; IPv6 off unless listed.
properties.trusted_workload: WSL networkingMode is VM-wide and observed only; no enforcement outside the distribution; network namespace shared with the Owner's distributions; disclosed.
properties.inspection: Connection attempts to the host gateway and other host addresses fail from the guest and from a container in it; positive control to an allowlisted endpoint succeeds; ip route, ip addr and ip -6 addr recorded.

properties.name: Identity
properties.strong: Unique instance name; machine-id and SSH host keys regenerated at create; guest user agent, non-root, no sudo by default; root SSH disabled; per-instance key in the harness state directory, never ~/.ssh; host-side provider principal recorded and disclosed (a kernel boundary, not a principal boundary).
properties.trusted_workload: Same rules inside the distribution or container.
properties.inspection: machine-id and host-key fingerprints differ across instances and recreate; id agent shows no sudo; sshd -T shows permitrootlogin no; provider query names the host principal.

properties.name: Pinned boot inputs
properties.strong: Image URL and sha256, firmware, kernel/initrd if direct boot, seed digest, provider binary version and profile git revision are pinned; the provider reports the digest it booted.
properties.trusted_workload: WSL imports a pinned tar by sha256.
properties.inspection: Launch record lists each input with its digest; a mismatch refuses the launch.

properties.name: Disposability
properties.strong: destroy removes the instance and its storage and nothing else; recreate reproduces the same observed state; the Owner's data roots are untouched.
properties.trusted_workload: Same; WSL destroy is wsl --unregister of the dedicated name only.
properties.inspection: Owner data-root inventory before and after; inspect records compared across recreate.

properties.name: Tier label
properties.strong: Every artifact carries tier, provider and nesting.

properties.name: Virtualization extensions
properties.strong: The guest never relies on them; exposure declared as nested_virt_exposed; strong profiles should mask them (for example Incus security.nesting=false); mask or declare is decided by F-03.2.1.
properties.trusted_workload: Observed and declared only; WSL nestedVirtualization is VM-wide and never written.
properties.inspection: grep -c -E 'vmx|svm' /proc/cpuinfo inside the guest, compared with nested_virt_exposed.
